summary_md: **Xuyewild ([@calmrisewild](https://x.com/calmrisewild/status/2116746706306113629))** after six months and thousands of AI drama clips, shares two bilingual repos with lessons on Seedance shots and handoffs between Claude and Codex on long projects ([xuyewild/multi-ai-skills](https://github.com/xuyewild/multi-ai-skills), [xuyewild/ai-video-skills](https://github.com/xuyewild/ai-video-skills)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - xuyewild/multi-ai-skills: Two skills I use when several AIs work on one long project: hand off through files, get a second AI to check, log paid generations before you click. English and Chinese.
